name: Sixty forty
description: Starts the strip with a large main column and a smaller one after it. Later columns open at the smaller size and the shortcut cycles forty, fifty, and sixty percent of the strip.

name: Tabbed halves
description: Two columns that each take half the strip and show their windows as tabs, so the screen stays split in two while each half holds as many windows as you like.

name: Thirds
description: The classic scrolling rhythm. New columns open at half the strip and the width shortcut cycles through one third, one half, and two thirds.
